pages.text: It learns, if I give it the means. Every piece of $(l)research$() costs three things: essence, drawn from the organisms wired to it; materials, from my pockets; and $(l)clues$().

pages.title: Clues
pages.text: Clues are things I have noticed and written down: a cow that forgot its weight, a mind gone vacant, dust that was alive, a tear in the air, the time left on a long road, the beats a heavy heart misses.$(br2)Each topic accepts several different sets of clues. Any one set will do, and it is spent.

pages.title: Deeper Infusion
pages.text: The first thing it offers to learn. Once understood, the $(l)Enhancing Gland$() fills me deeper: every power I hold grows to its $(l)second level$(). Diamond-hard fists; sight through sneaking; a wider, longer Stutter; more speed, more size, bigger pools.
